name: quality-review
details:
Phase 6: Quality Review for memory-mcp first commit.

Systematic code review using three parallel perspectives:
- Code simplicity, DRY principles, and elegance
- Functional correctness and bug detection
- Project conventions and architectural patterns

tasks.name: Launch Review Agents
tasks.details:
Launch 3 code-reviewer agents in parallel with different focuses:
1. Simplicity/DRY/elegance
2. Bugs/functional correctness
3. Project conventions/abstractions

tasks.name: Consolidate Findings
tasks.details: Review all agent findings and identify highest severity issues that need addressing

tasks.name: Present to User
tasks.details: Present consolidated findings to user and ask what they want to do (fix now, fix later, or proceed as-is)

tasks.name: Address Issues
tasks.details: Fix issues based on user decision
